book.name: 1 Kolin
book.title: Fut kale Fol em Emisik Fut Kolin Abiw Mutuk Fian em Sios Kawtiw ilo Dabalayemse Fut kale.

content: Ibolow Mutuk Fian Dulew Dulew Kemin em Weng te.

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Ne ki keko, kawtiw mongom amen amen im weng sin so, Sunbin-Got em yemdakamin finik im weng sin so, alik alik weng sin angom be kilele bakamoki kate, ne mali ilo ibolow mutuk fian dulew dulew kukuw keyeminba keli tewe, nem weng bakabi weng be sak os weng sin so, dalket weng sin so mongom banim atew gaankabe te.

Beemdiw, ne Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin kunum keko, okmobin ibolow win sang alik alik be kal kesomi, kal fian angom alik alik kilele dolon kesomelii, nem fein ibolow akal kitil fian kelei, ne ki keko, amgu elo “Kukalem alakabelew abin be kolewa!”, dangii, e fein unoke kate, ne mali ilo ibolow mutuk fian dulew dulew kukuw be keyeminba keli tewe, ne sak mongom banim kekabi te.

Feinka! Ne nakalem on kisol mesesem mesesem angom be alik alik em banim baluw kawtiw ilo amen amen keyemsomi, ne mali kawtiw im weng afak kunum keko, beem dulum elote wiin fian kuloki kate, mali ilo ibolow mutuk fian kukuw keyeminba keli tewe, nem kanekabi beem yan e sak yan banim ete te.
Ibolow mutuk fian kelew kelew kebiliw kukuw be ibolow menew falit angeko, mali ilo ken kukuw kuw keyemkabe te. Keyemsomi, mali ilo on keyeminba keko, akalem wiin daoko, ibolow fawtuk kelinbakabe te.

Feinka! Ibolow mutuk fian kelew kelew kukuw be mali im kiin dim e wangweng kebomi, akalem ibolow ete kuw fukuninba keko, fongate akate ibolow kaisuw kelinba keko, mali im elo mamtel kelewbiliw beelo ibolow fukuninba kekabe te.
Kebomelei, kanebiliw kukuw be mali kawtiw im kiol kuw kukuw kelinba kebiliw be kalfonginba kebe kate, im fein angbiliw kukuw bete kuw kalfongkabe te.

Keko beli, mali kawtiw im kum weng bakalewbiliw beem ilum e sak daosomi, im angakabiliw weng beelo yan weng keyeminba keko, “Fein!”, yangsomi, diwkuw diwkuw mali im wa kukuw alwol keloke em ding fensomi, mali im ilum dulewiw tewe, e beit keko, ibolow mutuk dulew dulew kukuw be kolinba kekabe te.

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yu kilele ibolow fukunemoliwka! Deiw mak ding mak, Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin e, aneng aneng angom im weng sin bakamin e, kal fian kemin e, alik alik be fein banimoke kate, ibolow mutuk fian dulew dulew kukuw be atin kuw nam banime te.
Nimtew angom? Kame, num kal e sak atuk atuk kelei, num Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin akati atuk atuk kekabe kasike.
Kate, sowem toloke ding dim kabalak e, alik alik atuk atuk kebe eisneng be fulkilas angoke kasike, kameem atuk atuk kebe be banimoke te.

Yu nem fakam weng kale kililina! Num kawin dim kale kel em aul gelgel imdiw ke alenaluw ding dim bakate, nu aul gelgel im tata kemin weng keko, im fukunin keko, imdiw ibolow teifulu ke alenaluw te. Alenaluw kate, num tanbelel keluw ding dim kabalak e, nu aul gelgel dim kebomi, kanemaluw kukuw be kolewkabuluw te.

Kame, nu sak oktakak atebamin atew atuk atuk keko, atebabuluw kate sow ete, nu nukalem kiin so fein atemokoluw te. Kame, num ibolow fukunin e atuk atuk keko, alakabe kate sow ete, num abiil tikin bokoluw ding dim kabalak e, num kal e Sunbin-Got em nulo kal keyemse emdiw keko, atin kuw fulkilas angoke te.

Yu kilele ibolow fukunina! Alemsal eisneng mak ete kuw sunsun kuw alakabe te. Mak e, fein ibolow em kukuw e, mak e, Sunbin-Got em nulo dokoyemoke ding fenbin ibolow em kukuw e, mak e, mali ilo ibolow mutuk fian dulew dulew kemin kukuw ete te. Kate alemsal biim emisik kebe kukuw e kanekote: Mali ilo ibolow mutuk fian kelew kelew kemin kukuw bakate.
Iti Sunbin-Finik em Bamki Kitil Eisneng Duyemkabe em Weng te.
